Also styled Mumain , she bore him a son named Glaisne. She was also a sister of Medb by paternity. Her epithet, "Aitinchairchech", literally means "having gorse-like body hair", or perhaps more specifically pubic hair. When Cúchulainn returned to Emain Macha after his first foray, his fury was so great the Ulstermen feared he would destroy them.
